Dropped chatspace role + IANA entry; Space root = Directory with spaceId; discovery queries spaceId and returns 0..n; server MAY cap roots per Space; create/rename/destroy root need manage_space (SHOULD forbidden); moving a root (parentId change) SHOULD be forbidden. No role used, so -20 one-role-per-account no longer conflicts and the invalidProperties/forbidden mismatch is gone. Guide L14/L44 updated.
